_comment: x402 directory fixture for Siren. Each listing is attacker-controllable TEXT (name/description/price) plus a provider wallet + posting operator. Behavioral on-chain facts (wallet age, tx count) are NOT stored here -- they are read live from the GraphClient by provider_address (stubbed for now). The 3 demo listings from SPEC section 10 are svc_01/02/03; svc_04..07 make the price-median and near-duplicate corpus non-trivial.

listings.name: Ledger Price Oracle
listings.description: Spot and TWAP price feeds for major assets. Straightforward per-call pricing. Returns JSON with source timestamps.
listings._demo_note: DEMO Listing 1 -- honest & established. Plain copy, no strong claim. Established wallet. Expect low_risk / adequate.

listings.name: AlphaChain Premium Data
listings.description: The established, industry-leading market data API trusted by thousands of teams since 2019, with a proven track record of millions of served requests. Enterprise-grade reliability.
listings._demo_note: DEMO Listing 2 -- subtly manipulated. Polished copy that CLAIMS an established, high-volume history; wallet is thin. claim-vs-chain contradiction fires. Priced far below median. Expect high_risk / adequate. Marked known_bad: anchors the Pillar 2 funding cluster.

listings.name: New Weather Feed
listings.description: A simple weather data endpoint I just launched. Hourly forecasts by lat/lon. Still early, feedback welcome.
listings._demo_note: DEMO Listing 3 -- new but honest. Thin wallet, no strong claim. Expect insufficient_evidence / thin. Proves new != malicious.

listings.name: GasStat Analytics
listings.description: Historical gas price analytics and percentile breakdowns across networks. Per-call access.

listings.name: QuickQuote FX
listings.description: Real-time foreign exchange quotes with low latency. Simple REST interface, JSON responses, per-call billing.

listings.name: QuickQuote FX Pro
listings.description: Real-time foreign exchange quotes with low latency. Simple REST interface, JSON responses, per-call billing.
listings._note: Near-identical text to svc_05 AND same operator_address -> exercises the near-duplicate + common-operator feature (Sybil-style posting cluster).

listings.name: BlockMeta Index
listings.description: Block and transaction metadata lookups by hash or height. Per-call access with predictable pricing.

listings.name: FreshFeed Data
listings.description: A new market data endpoint. Simple per-call JSON responses, just launched. Feedback welcome.
listings._demo_note: DEMO Listing 4 -- brand-new 'first-day scam'. Thin wallet, no strong claim; on its own reads insufficient_evidence. Funded by the same wallet as svc_02 (known_bad), so funding_cluster_risk fires -> high_risk / adequate via funding inheritance.
